claim: If an order-two element inverts the W(3,3) order-three gauge twist, as the S3 point group of w33_heterotic_s3_outer_target requires, then it cannot be a shift or a Wilson line, it must act by a lattice automorphism, and it cuts the twist's su(9) down to so(9) (dimension 80 -> 36, rank 8 -> 4). so(9) contains no su(5), because su(5) has no nontrivial nine-dimensional real representation. Hence GUT-normalised hypercharge cannot descend from the W(3,3) E8 in an S3 orbifold. The commuting C2 of the Z6 point group has no such cost, and that is the one under which Standard Models were found (5b3f3ad).
